constructor
· intro h_mono
  intros s a h_not_in
  exact h_mono s (insert a s) h_not_in

· intro h_insert
  intros s t h_subset
  let diff := t \ s
  let mut curr := s
  let mut rem := diff
  while rem ≠ ∅ do
    let a := rem.choose
    let new_curr := insert a curr
    have h1 : curr ⊆ new_curr := by simp [insert_subset]
    have h2 : a ∉ curr := by simp [not_in_insert]
    have h3 : f curr ≤ f new_curr := h_insert curr a h2
    exact h3
    curr := new_curr
    rem := rem \ {a}
  exact h_insert s a h2
